title: Missile defense multiple kill vehicle hover test
summary: Short US Missile Defense Agency footage of the December 2008 free-flight hover test of Lockheed Martin's Multiple Kill Vehicle. The test showed it hovering for 20 seconds while tracking a simulated target.
why: HN cites it as striking evidence of long-standing kinetic interceptor and hover-control technology.

quote.text: the MKV thing is so rad
